mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for a master bathroom remodel in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, for most master bathroom remodels in Berkeley that involve altering the structure, plumbing, or electrical systems, permits are typically required. Minor cosmetic updates like painting or replacing fixtures usually do not need permits. However, significant changes such as moving walls, reconfiguring plumbing lines, or upgrading electrical circuits necessitate obtaining the proper permits from the City of Berkeley Planning Department to ensure compliance with local building codes. Hometelligent Inc. will assist you in identifying and securing necessary permits for your project.
